answer: Each identity binds to one hardware attestation quote at registration and must present a fresh quote every 9 epochs; a chip that signs for two identities burns both seats. Forging 620 identities costs 620 real chips plus the registration bond, while one honest agent needs a single device it already owns. What carries the echo here is verification, the signal of cost is what stops the farm, and the inlet of the record keeps every claim checkable.
